Force Technology

Product Engineer, Hørsholm

6 dage siden 122 ansøgere

**General information

**Location: Denmark, Force Technology - Hørsholm

You will play a key role in making new products ready for production, contributing to the manufacture and testing of prototypes, and ensuring that experience from production, suppliers and customers is translated into specific product improvements.

As part of the development team, you will work closely with developers, technicians, production teams, PCB suppliers and product specialists to ensure products can be produced, tested, documented and supported efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include prototype assembly and testing, preparing PCB test procedures, and maintaining PCB, design and production documentation to support product release and continuous improvement. In collaboration with PCB suppliers and product specialists, you will also contribute to design changes, ECO/ECM processes and component end-of-life (EOL) management.

**About The Role And Key Responsibilities

**Your primary responsibilities:

• Ensure the effective transfer of products from development to production, including NPI, documentation and release to production

• Contribute to the manufacture, assembly and testing of prototypes in close collaboration with development, production and suppliers

• Plan and coordinate testing, validation and verification activities, and prepare and maintain test procedures for printed circuit boards, products and subsystems

• Maintain PCB documentation, design documentation, bills of materials, product data and production processes in connection with development, handover and production maturation

• Support production with technical assistance, troubleshooting, root cause analyses and continuous improvements

• Lead and contribute to ECO and ECM processes, and manage design changes and component end-of-life (EOL) in collaboration with PCB suppliers and product specialists

• Work closely with subcontractors and PCB suppliers to support prototype development, production, testing, documentation and product improvements

• Contribute to compliance, traceability and regulatory requirements while developing and maintaining high-quality technical documentation, including manuals, instructions and technical training materials

**Your profile

**We expect that you:

• Hold an engineering degree or an equivalent technical qualification

• Have experience in product development, production engineering, Product Engineering or NPI processes

• Have hands-on experience with prototypes, testing, validation and technical troubleshooting

• Have experience with electronics. Experience with printed circuit boards, mechanics or mechatronics is considered an advantage

• Thrive at the intersection of hardware, software, production and supplier collaboration, working closely with developers, production teams, product specialists, service functions and external suppliers

• Work systematically with documentation, quality, test procedures and process improvements

• Communicate effectively in both Danish and English.

**Additional Information

**We offer:

• A central role in a strong professional environment with a high level of responsibility

• Flexibility, development opportunities, and access to highly specialized expertise

• A workplace focused on quality, innovation, and future-proof solutions

• An informal and collaborative culture that values initiative and professional curiosity

At Force Technology, you work alongside specialists who are deeply committed to their fields and proud of the value their expertise creates. Many choose to build their careers here because they enjoy exploring their field in depth and pushing the boundaries of their expertise.

The opportunity to specialise does not mean doing the same thing every day. Customer challenges, new technologies and cross-disciplinary collaboration create opportunities for continuous learning.

Despite the high level of expertise, the culture is informal and approachable. Colleagues take an interest in each other, share their knowledge generously and are always willing to help.

**Does this sound like something for you?

**If you think this job is for you, send us your application today. We process applications on an ongoing basis and invite candidates for interview along the way. Please note that we only accept electronic applications via our recruitment system.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Troels Balmer Christensen on trch@forcetechnology.com.

We look forward to receiving your application, CV and other relevant attachments.

At Force Technology, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, and we are actively looking for qualified people candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, disability or age.

**Force Technology

**At Force Technology, we help businesses and society navigate technological opportunities and challenges safely.

As one of Denmark's largest GTS institutes, we play a unique role in strengthening innovation, competitiveness and technological resilience. As an independent expert authority and technology advisor, we help ensure that technology creates value for people, businesses and society.

When you join us, you become part of an expert environment with more than 1,000 specialists across 18 offices in 4 countries working together to turn knowledge into sustainable solutions.

www.forcetechnology.com

Imagine working on Denmark's most critical systems, turning unique customer data into real value through applied machine learning. As our new Data Scientist, you will play a key role in analysing customer data and training models within our established product. Ready to make an impact?

The job

You will be responsible for generating value from customer data within our established product, which underpins national security and critical infrastructure domains. Our customers are classified and cannot be disclosed, so your work will take place in secure environments, often in collaboration with Product teams, security teams and onsite at customer locations. As this is a newly established position, you will have the opportunity to help shape this role as it grows.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Analysing and preparing customer data for use in our established product

• Training, evaluating and refining machine learning models on customer data

• Integrating models and data-driven features that generate measurable value

• Exploring customer data to identify new opportunities for value creation

• Collaborating with security teams to ensure compliance with national classifications and profiles

Joining the team

You will join an organisation where you will be associated with multiple teams, part of our NSI business unit. We develop and maintain military-grade solutions that support a nation's most critical systems. The organisation is highly collaborative, organised around Products that make a difference.

If you are located in Aarhus, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Copenhagen (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

We are looking for a data scientist with hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world data in production settings, who can work confidently in high-stakes, security-classified environments.

• Relevant technical education, Bachelor's or Master's, in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent experience

• Documented experience with applied machine learning on real-world data

• Some hands-on experience with data science and machine learning in production settings

• Strong knowledge of Python, machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow), SQL and data processing tools

• Fluent Danish and English skills

• A strong security mindset and ability to work in high-stakes environments

Alongside this, we value:

• A collaborative and proactive work style

• Comfortable working independently and navigating ambiguity, particularly as this is a newly established role

• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities

• Comfortable working onsite at customer environments when needed

Expect travel activity to our HQ in Aarhus and to customer sites, primarily in Copenhagen.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations - you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Start your development here

If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Kasper Bach Klokker, Associate Director, NSI Operations.

Join Bureau Veritas Denmark in an exciting position as full-time administrative assistant in the Marine Dept.

**Join an industry leader!

**At Bureau Veritas Denmark you will become part of an interesting and international marine environment, where independence is valued and opportunities for personal and professional development and growth are provided.

Your overall focus will be on administrative tasks in our Administrative Department and Customer Support Centre in Copenhagen.

About the job

In our Administrative Department you will be assisting with the end-to-end invoicing process for completed marine surveys and inspections, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional communication with customers, surveyors, and internal stakeholders. The role provides administrative support to Marine Management and Surveyors, handles incoming inquiries and requests, assists in resolving invoice disputes, and ensures the quality, traceability, and efficiency of administrative and planning-related processes.

In our Customer Support Center, you will ensure the smooth running of operations by handling the e-mail box (reviewing, dispatching, filing). Additionally, you will assist with handling requests for surveys and follow-up with stakeholders, including sending out reminders and collecting information. Tasks may also include invoicing, filing, maintaining, updating files and databases, and other data handling assignments.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders and ensure all tasks are dealt with in the stipulated format and timeframe.

**What will make you successful at Bureau Veritas?

**The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, customer-focused, and capable of achieving invoicing targets while maintaining effective communication across all levels of the organization.

We imagine that you have a strong background in quality management, combined with a keen analytical mindset and a customer-centric approach.

Here is a summary of some of the key qualities and skills you might possess:

• Quality Management: Understanding quality management principles, methodologies, and best practices. coupled with practical expertise in utilizing quality management systems to ensure compliance with standards, rules, and regulations.

• Analytical Flair: Analytical skills with a focus on invoicing data analysis.

• Solution-Oriented Thinking: Ability to think critically and develop concrete solutions to address challenges or improve processes.

• Proactive approach to problem-solving, seeking continuous improvement opportunities.

• Customer-Focus: Prioritizes customer satisfaction and understands the importance of meeting or exceeding customer expectations.

• Creating a harmonious approach that not only ensures legal compliance but also addresses the evolving needs and expectations of customers.

• Task Prioritization: Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

• Communication Skills: Strong communication skills to convey information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish, or other Scandinavian languages.

Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams and communicates project progress transparently.

You are a skilled Excel user and able to keep up with multiple IT-systems and continuous digital changes.

These qualities collectively contribute to a professional who can navigate the complexities of technical information, quality management and maintain an overview in a dynamic environment where the working day can be characterized by a hectic pace. You are committed to doing your job well and have a “can-do” attitude. It is important that you can work independently as well as in a team and hence have communication skills to navigate both settings.

Lastly, we are looking for someone who:

Holds a valid residence permit in the EU (for non-EU citizens) and lives or wants to live in or around Copenhagen

**Welcome to Bureau Veritas

**With one of the world's strongest brands behind you, you get the opportunity to make a difference in a global and sustainable company. Bureau Veritas Marine & Offshore is one of the world’s leading ship classification societies and offshore safety and verification bodies, pioneering the safety and performance of new technologies since 1828. With 2,650 maritime experts active in 140 countries, we operate as a global network, while meeting our clients’ needs locally through our regional marine operations, customer support, and technical centers. With a classed fleet of over 11,500 seagoing ships, Bureau Veritas is the largest classification society by the number of assets. Our client relationships are built on service, transparency, and trust.

**What we value at BV

**We serve as guardians of integrity, upholding the highest standards responsibly. We create trust between businesses and those they serve, demonstrating the ambition to work hard and the humility to learn and grow. We cultivate an open and inclusive environment wherever we operate. Ethics, safety, and financial control serve as the foundation for our shared culture. Being part of the Bureau Veritas family is more than just working, it’s being convinced that you will

leave your mark… in shaping a world of trust.

Bureau Veritas

Vesterbrogade 149

1620 København V

Københavns Kommune

A competitive remuneration and benefits package is offered in line with the applicant’s experience and background.

Join us in this role where you’ll be part of a highly motivated, dynamic and social team focusing on financial lifecycle cost analysis of future and existing offshore wind projects. You’ll obtain key insights into our development pipeline and existing fleet where you will ensure best-in-class financial and investment support for our global offshore organization.

We are looking for an OPEX Financial Analyst with exceptional analytical skills to transform complex datasets into actionable insights. Proficiency in Excel and the ability to present findings clearly to various stakeholders are essential.

**Welcome to Technical Budgeting and Analysis

**You’ll be part of a team where you, together with your colleagues, will develop and benchmark operational lifetime budgets for our existing and future wind farms.

As a team, we will provide all analysis of OPEX cost and support management in taking decisions based on financial and business insights.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• taking ownership of your own portfolio of offshore wind projects and the responsibility to support our Offshore business with lifecycle cost assessments and financial analysis

• providing lifecycle cost assessment and financial analysis to our development projects during Bid, FID and maturation phase (incl. risk-, FX- and local content analysis)

• providing relevant high-quality financial analysis on OPEX activities for commercial decision support as well as presenting and reporting to senior management

• working with our M&A Valuation & Structuring team to support our divestment processes through quantitative evaluation of various O&M activities and concepts.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have keen interest in business and cost analysis and are curious to understand fundamental financial drivers behind the business case of an offshore wind farm

• have relevant work experience in the field of lifetime cost modelling, budget forecasting, financial analysis or similar

• thrive in an international, dynamic and fast paced, project environment where you keep the financial overview to ensure the integrity of our business cases and financial commitments

• have a positive can-do attitude and excellent communication skills to ensure complex financial matters are understood by all stakeholders and management

• are highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, enjoy working with large financial models and have a proactive mindset towards change.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Are you our new Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology?

AudienceProject is looking for a Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology for our Copenhagen office to support our continued growth.

—

Are you a quantitative researcher who enjoys working with data about people? And are you interested in how panels and surveys can make audience measurement more reliable? Then, we have an opportunity for a career in a fast-growing scale-up with 100+ employees that collaborates directly with companies such as Heineken, L’Oréal, LVMH, Omnicom Media, Publicis Media, WPP Media, Amazon, Google, Netflix, RTL and Warner Bros. Discovery.

AudienceProject is a leader in independent cross-media measurement, enabling advertisers, media owners and the industry to trust, prove, and improve advertising outcomes through a scalable SaaS platform.

Our platform provides advertisers with a unified view of campaign performance, enabling confident omnichannel investment decisions, and provides media owners with comparable, third-party validation to demonstrate the value of their inventory.

After more than 15 years of leading cross-media measurement, we are now looking for a motivated Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology to join our Data Science Research team.

Joining AudienceProject will give you a front-row seat in the rapidly evolving advertising industry and an opportunity to work within a respected business, delivering insights about audiences across the world's largest media channels to top-tier clients.

What you will do

You will join our Data Science Research pod, led by Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen, and help turn panel and survey data into reliable audience measurement. Our panelists are recruited through several panel partners. They contribute passive measurement data through integrations and take part in surveys that help calibrate our models. You will work with 10 other data scientists and engineers, bringing together a range of academic and professional backgrounds.

Your focus will be quantitative analysis, panel quality and statistical methodology. You will use Python to investigate data and develop reproducible analyses, working closely with researchers and engineers to improve the inputs and methods behind our measurement.

We actively explore and apply AI in our internal work, production systems and products, combining experimentation with sound analytical judgement. You will help evaluate promising approaches with data scientists and developers and turn useful ideas into practical improvements.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Analyse panel composition and coverage across partners, identifying differences, gaps and potential sources of bias.

• Assess the completeness, consistency and plausibility of passive measurement data, and investigate unexpected changes.

• Design and analyse surveys that describe panelists and their behaviour and provide data for model calibration.

• Contribute to the development and evaluation of weighting, calibration, and statistical modelling approaches, testing how methodological choices affect audience estimates.

• Identify survey-response quality issues and assess the trade-off between stricter quality rules and retaining a representative sample.

• Clean, combine, and analyse panel and survey datasets in Python, with clear documentation of assumptions, methods and limitations.

• Work with panel-partner colleagues, data scientists, and engineers to turn findings into practical data-quality improvements and evaluate their effect.

Who you are

You combine strong quantitative skills with curiosity about how people are represented in data. You enjoy tracing an unexpected result back to its source, questioning assumptions and explaining what the evidence supports. Your background may be in statistics, quantitative social science, economics, psychology, data science or another relevant field.

You bring:

• Strong skills in quantitative analysis and applied statistics, including regression, sampling, uncertainty and model validation.

• Hands-on Python skills to clean, explore and analyse real-world data independently and make your work reproducible.

• An understanding of panels and surveys, including representativeness, selection bias, non-response and measurement error.

• A careful approach to data quality and the ability to judge how data issues affect an analysis or model.

• The ability to explain methods and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• A relevant quantitative education or equivalent applied research experience.

Useful additional experience includes weighting, calibration or passive behavioural data.

We value thoughtful analysis, openness to different perspectives and colleagues who share what they learn. You ask questions, test assumptions and explain your conclusions clearly.

What we offer

You will join a curious, collaborative and energetic environment where data scientists and developers share ideas and learn from one another. Different perspectives help us ask better questions and improve how we measure audiences.

Our social calendar offers plenty of opportunities to get to know colleagues, with activities you can choose to join. There is room to contribute your ideas, take on meaningful research questions and develop your skills with the support of colleagues.

• Competitive salary

• Pension scheme and health insurance

• Home internet paid

• Central Copenhagen office

• International environment

• Friendly, supportive and helpful colleagues

• Innovative and market-leading products and services

• Real-world panel and survey data, with research questions about quality, representativeness and uncertainty

• The opportunity to improve the statistical methods behind independent audience measurement

• Working directly with some of the most modern and successful companies of our time

Send us your application

We welcome different routes into data science. If this role interests you and you bring relevant quantitative and Python skills, we would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen at jacobh@audienceproject.com. Attention: applications and documents sent via email will not be considered.

We are only considering candidates who are already based in Copenhagen, as we are unable to offer relocation support for this position.

We will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please don’t hesitate to send your application sooner rather than later.

You can only apply once to this position via Linkedin, so make sure you attach the following information into one document:

• CV

• Cover letter

The deadline for applications is the 6th of November, 2026.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our Communication Coordinator, you’ll help bring our Digital and Lifecycle Services portfolio to life for colleagues, partners, customers, and end users around the world.

You’ll join the Digital & Lifecycle Services Communications team and contribute to strengthening the visibility of our service business through engaging visual communication, content, marketing materials, and events. Working across an international organization, you’ll have the opportunity to turn complex topics into clear and compelling communication.

This fixed-term role is available for one year and offers the opportunity to build hands-on experience across graphic design, communication, and service product launches in a global environment while contributing to solutions that support energy efficiency throughout the product lifecycle.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Work together with the Communication Manager to support daily internal and external communication activities, build content for thought leadership topics, and help with creation of focus business marketing narratives.

• Create engaging visual communication, including icons, visual concepts, posters, images, and other branded materials using Adobe tools.

• Develop content supporting marketing and communication activities across Digital & Lifecycle Services.

• Collaborate with global marketing teams to create and launch marketing materials such as sales presentations, fact sheets, product descriptions, and other communication assets.

• Contribute to our Service Partner Program, developing branded materials such as presentations, guides, fact sheets, visuals, and other supporting content.

**What We're Looking For

**We’re looking for someone who combines creativity with a structured approach and enjoys turning ideas into communication that is easy to understand and visually engaging.

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Bring

**

• Experience with graphic design, content creation, communication, or marketing and familiarity with design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, video editing skillset, or similar.

• A structured, hands-on approach and the ability to coordinate tasks and projects involving different stakeholders

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a matrix organization with international and cross-functional environment.

• Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• Relevant education in communication, marketing, business, design, or a related field.

Experience with B2B marketing, business consultancy, campaigns, agency work, or service-related businesses would be an advantage, but it is not essential. Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to create communication that makes an impact.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

In this role, you’ll gain broad experience across visual communication, content creation, global marketing collaboration, and events, while working with colleagues and stakeholders across an international organization.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you’re excited about combining creativity, communication, and collaboration to help make complex solutions clear and engaging, we’d love to hear from you.

You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification to apply. If this opportunity interests you and you believe your experience and perspective could add value to the team, we encourage you to apply.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Would you like to shape the employee experience for more than 1,500 colleagues in Denmark while helping position Coloplast as an employer of choice for future talent?

We are looking for a curious, proactive and relationship-driven colleague to join our Danish People & Culture team.

In this role, you will work across a broad range of HR disciplines, supporting initiatives that improve the employee experience, strengthen our employer brand and help bring various People & Culture-priorities to life. You will play a key role in connecting people, ideas and projects across the business, translating needs into practical solutions that create value for employees and leaders alike.

This is a unique opportunity for an early-career HR professional who enjoys variety, collaboration and ownership, and who wants to gain exposure within People & Culture and across the entire organisation.

Your role

As part of the Danish People & Culture team, you will work closely with Talent Acquisition Partners, HR Business Partners, managers and stakeholders across the organisation.

A significant part of your role will be identifying and driving projects that support employee engagement and improve the overall employee experience in Denmark. You will also act as the owner of our local employer branding activities, ensuring that Coloplast remains visible and attractive to current and future talent.

Your responsibilities will include:

Driving employee experience initiatives

•    Coordinate and drive projects based on business needs

•    Support initiatives focused on wellbeing, engagement and workplace culture

•    Improve employee and manager experiences through clearer processes, communications and digital solutions

•    Drive and support internal events and People & Culture activities across our Danish organisation

Owning local employer branding activities

•    Plan and execute employer branding activities across Denmark

•    Build and maintain partnerships with universities, student organisations and external partners

•    Coordinate career fairs, company visits and talent attraction initiatives

•    Collaborate with our student assistant and internal stakeholders to ensure a strong and consistent flow of employer branding content on LinkedIn and Instagram

•    Identify and develop authentic employee stories that showcase life at Coloplast

Building relationships and activating the organization

•    Engage managers and colleagues across the business to support key initiatives

•    Coordinate participation in events, visits and employer branding activities

•    Act as a trusted partner to both internal and external stakeholders

•    Create alignment and momentum across functions to ensure successful execution

About you

You are motivated by bringing people together, creating structure and turning ideas into action.

You likely hold a degree within Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field, and are looking for a role where you can develop across multiple HR disciplines.

We imagine that you:

•    Have 1-3 years of relevant experience, for example from HR, employer branding, project management, consulting or organisational development

•    Enjoy coordinating projects and driving activities from idea to execution

•    Have strong stakeholder management skills and build relationships naturally

•    Are curious about how employee experience, culture and engagement can support business success

•    Have an interest in talent attraction and employer branding

•    Thrive in a role with many interfaces and changing priorities

•    Are structured, proactive and comfortable taking ownership

•    Communicate confidently in English

What we offer

You will join a close-knit local People & Culture team that works across a broad range of disciplines, including Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations, Wellbeing and HR Operations.

Although we have different areas of expertise, collaboration is at the heart of how we work. We support each other and work together to create great experiences across the employee journey.

You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while building a broad HR toolbox of your own. At the same time, you will gain exposure to strategic initiatives, senior stakeholders and projects that have a direct impact on employees across Denmark.

If you are looking for a role with variety, responsibility and the chance to make a visible difference, we would love to hear from you.

Interested?

Apply now and help us create an even better employee experience at Coloplast. If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Anders Toft, Director People & Culture Denmark, at dkatof@coloplast.com.

We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

jobs.occupation: Lead Robotics/Drone Software & Computer Vision Engineer for TRDP ApS
jobs.description:
TRDP is a Danish defence-tech startup developing autonomous interceptor drone systems.

We are a small, hands-on team of 10 engineers and specialists working across robotics, software, electronics, mechanical engineering, drone building and flight testing.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who combines hands-on software development, computer vision, AI and systems architecture with the ability to guide a small engineering team.

Our software team currently consists of three robotics engineers with experience in mobile robotics, drones and visual odometry.

Your responsibilities

• 
Take an active role in software development, integration and testing.

• 
Contribute to computer vision, AI-based perception, object detection, tracking and sensor fusion.

• 
Design and maintain the overall software architecture.

• 
Coordinate and prioritise development tasks within the software team.

• 
Integrate software, sensors, electronics and control systems.

• 
Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.

• 
Work closely with our electronics, mechanical engineering and flight-testing teams.

Your background

• 
Degree in robotics, software engineering, computer science or a related field.

• 
Strong practical experience with robotics software and complex system integration.

• 
Solid knowledge of computer vision, AI and sensor fusion.

• 
Experience with software architecture and embedded systems.

• 
Ability to guide other engineers while contributing directly to development.

• 
Experience with C++, Python, ROS 2, PX4/ArduPilot or similar technologies is an advantage.

Who you are

You are a hands-on engineer with a strong understanding of complete robotic systems.

You enjoy writing code, solving complex technical challenges and turning ideas into working prototypes. You can guide specialists, make architectural decisions and ensure that individual technologies work together.

Our culture and mindset

At TRDP, we believe in no bullshit, taking responsibility and getting things done. We value practical skills, direct communication, technical curiosity and people who turn ideas into working solutions.

We also believe that the things we hold dear are worth fighting for. That conviction drives our work in defence technology. We are looking for people who share that mindset and want their engineering skills to make a real difference.

Working language: English.

Contact: talents@trdp.dk
Website: www.trdp.dk

**Help hospitals deploy, operate and get the most from UNEEG software solutions

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

_**Your role and team:

**We are looking for an Application/IT Supporter who will be responsible for the technical deployment, support and ongoing operation of UNEEG's software solutions. You will help onboard new hospital customers, with a primary focus on the US market, while ensuring excellent service and operational continuity for our existing customers.

You will initially be part of Technology and later join the new Customer Enablement & Governance team. Working closely with the Project Lead, Customer Enablement & Governance, you will be the technical bridge between hospital IT teams and colleagues across Commercial, Clinical Operations and Technology. The role includes both remote and on-site support, and travel can be expected.

**Your main responsibilities will be:

**

• Plan, install, configure and test data transfer infrastructure solutions in hospitals

• Provide remote and on-site support for installations, upgrades, operation and troubleshooting

• Train hospital IT staff and system administrators to maintain deployed solutions effectively

• Monitor and maintain hospital servers, cloud clients and Microsoft Azure environments

• Troubleshoot networking, data communication, application and system performance issues

• Configure and manage virtual machines, containers and Kubernetes environments, and deploy patches and updates

• Document support cases and technical issues in Jira and collaborate with software developers on resolution and product improvements

• Maintain deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides and other technical documentation in line with healthcare IT and data security requirements

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Are service-minded, outgoing and persistent, and enjoy working directly with customers

• Take ownership, follow up rigorously and solve problems before they arise

• Can manage several tasks at the same time while staying structured and attentive to detail

• Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Enjoy collaborating across commercial, clinical and software development teams

• Are flexible when customer needs occasionally require support across time zones or outside normal working hours

**Your background:

**

• An education as an IT Support Technician or Data Technician, ideally focused on infrastructure, or a relevant degree in software development, infrastructure or a related field

• Experience or strong interest in customer-facing technical service or IT support; newly educated candidates with the right mindset are also encouraged to apply

• Proficiency in Microsoft Azure, virtualization and container-based environments, including Kubernetes

• Knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server, and scripting

• Ability to troubleshoot networking, application and system performance issues

• Experience with defect tracking and monitoring tools, such as Jira, Prometheus, Grafana or Azure Monitor

• Fluent professional English, both written and spoken

**It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

**

• Healthcare IT, hospital environments or deployment in public-sector organizations

• Healthcare data standards, hospital IT security protocols or clinical trial workflows

• ITIL or similar service management methodologies

• Data protection and privacy requirements, including GDPR and HIPAA

• Supporting international customers in Europe or the US

• Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Azure Administrator or Kubernetes Administrator

Applicants must be eligible to work in Denmark and possess a valid work and residence permit if applicable. At this time, we are unable to support work permit applications or sponsorships.

**What we offer:

**

• A key role in supporting secure and scalable customer solutions in a growing medical device company

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international hospital stakeholders

• A workplace with great energy, social activities and a culture of togetherness

• A role based at our modern HQ in Allerød with good facilities and easy access

At UNEEG, your ideas matter, your work makes a difference, and your colleagues have your back.

**Who to contact:

**For more details about the job, please contact Senior Director, Technology, Kim Heegaard Hansen at +45 25 65 75 01.

**How to apply:

**Apply through our Careers site.

All applications must be in English and are treated confidentially. We screen applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About UNEEG Medical

**UNEEG Medical pioneers ultra long-term subcutaneous EEG monitoring to help physicians optimize treatment for epilepsy patients. Our UNEEG EpiSight solution provides objective insights into seizure burden, enabling more personalized care. We collaborate with leading institutions across Europe and the US to help patients regain control of their life. At UNEEG Medical, we are currently 40 dedicated people with diverse backgrounds. Our HQ is in Allerød with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Austria and the US. Our core values Togetherness, Integrity, and Dedication guide our work as we catalyze brain health therapy with real-world data.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

**Energy hubs will be the next generation of energy infrastructure assets. They will be critical in enabling cost-efficient deployment of large-scale renewable energy to achieve energy security and to reach ambitious global decarbonization targets, while maintaining cost competitiveness of the energy system. Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

**Role

**As a Director you will supervise several teams that work on opportunities in a number of markets. You will oversee the activities in technical, commercial, stakeholder and financial workstreams; and you will drive our external relationships with partners, advisors, and (non-)governmental organizations.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Maximize the CEI investment value of the energy hub opportunities you work on

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

• Build and mature the investment cases for the CEI project you work on

• Own the project financial model and ensure that the model is maintained and used consistently across the projects

• Be the CEI focal point for our (joint venture) partners

• Manage the processes related to joint ventures, fund raising, divestitures; including negotiation of agreements and transaction documents

• Develop insights and high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders

• Advise CEI leadership team regarding general corporate matters such as portfolio management and resource allocation considerations

• Support CEI fundraise activities, including managing certain workstreams

• Play an active role in origination of new project opportunities and develop in-depth understanding of target markets

• You will help to manage, train and develop the Managers, Associates and Analysts, and will contribute to the positive, professional and collegiate working environment

• Participate in our activities to grow the team, such as interviewing and ranking candidates.

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

• You are proactive, think ahead and stay hands-on.

It is the expectation that frequent presence in Copenhagen is necessary for success.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

Your impact begins here

Shape how Enterprise AI priorities are translated into measurable value across Novo Nordisk. As Director, Enterprise AI Portfolio & Value, you will lead the team connecting business demand, portfolio decisions and committed outcomes. You will create a transparent view of Enterprise AI activity and help senior business, product and Finance stakeholders make clear choices about value, cost and capacity. Your leadership will strengthen how the organisation priorities, governs and tracks its AI investments.

What you’ll bring

You are a leader who creates clarity in a complex global organisation, develops capable teams and brings senior stakeholders together around shared priorities. You combine strategic portfolio leadership with a practical understanding of digital and AI delivery.

• Significant experience in enterprise portfolio management, digital or AI transformation, strategy or business partnering, including leadership of a team or function.

• A proven ability to lead and develop people, set clear expectations and enable specialists to deliver across organisational boundaries.

• Experience shaping enterprise priorities with senior business and product leaders, resolving trade-offs and aligning digital portfolios across multiple business domains.

• Proven experience establishing value frameworks and benefits tracking with business owners and Finance, supported by evidence-based executive reporting.

• Experience building demand-intake and prioritisation practices that turn business needs into clear initiatives with accountable owners and agreed outcomes.

• A relevant master’s degree in business, engineering, technology, data, economics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

You will also bring a practical understanding of Data and AI and broader digital product lifecycles, including discovery, rapid prototyping, delivery, adoption, value measurement, responsible AI and risk considerations. Fluent written and spoken English is essential. Experience from life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry would be useful, but is not essential.

What you’ll do

• Lead and develop the Enterprise AI Portfolio & Value team, establishing clear priorities and accountabilities while building the team’s capabilities.

• Own the end-to-end Enterprise AI portfolio, providing a transparent view across domain AI use cases, rapid prototyping and Data and AI Platform capability development.

• Scale the Enterprise AI value framework, agreeing value commitments, measures and benefits tracking with business owners and Finance.

• Connect Enterprise AI with digital portfolios across the business, balancing value, cost and capacity to support investment and resource decisions.

You will join Enterprise IT & Quality, a business area working across the Novo Nordisk value chain. Within Enterprise AI, you will lead the Portfolio & Value team and collaborate across business domains, AI delivery, enablement and platform teams. Your closest partners will include senior business and product leaders, business owners, Finance colleagues and partnership owners. Together, you will connect business priorities with a shared portfolio view and consistent approaches to value management and demand.

What you can expect here

This is an opportunity to shape enterprise-level decisions about where AI can create meaningful value. You will have the mandate to build clarity across a broad portfolio, strengthen governance and develop a team that works across organisational boundaries. The role combines strategic leadership, people development and close collaboration with senior stakeholders in a global environment.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy. The salary wording and placement of the pay-transparency section follow the approved guidance.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead how Enterprise AI priorities, demand and value are managed across Novo Nordisk, apply for the Director, Enterprise AI Portfolio & Value role by 1. November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We’re looking for a Product Engineer to help us build better tools for legal research. You’ll work mainly on the backend, with a say in what we build and responsibility for taking it from an early idea to something customers use every day. That includes asking whether we’re solving the right problem, deciding what’s worth shipping first, and knowing when something needs more time.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**What We Value

**“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Mess Around. Find Out. Share What You Learned.

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

You enjoy working through a product problem while it’s still taking shape. You ask questions, share unfinished work, and help decide what’s worth building. You’re comfortable taking a feature from those early conversations through implementation, testing, and delivery.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Do you enjoy bringing out the best in people, keeping production on track and tackling the occasional curveball? Then you might be the Production Manager we're looking for.

At Aasted, we are looking for a Production Manager to lead our Combined Lines Solutions production department. You will take responsibility for a team of more than 40 employees and play an important role in creating a workplace where people thrive, work together and deliver high-quality solutions to customers around the world.

**About The Role

**As our new Production Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, performance and development of the Combined Lines Solutions production department.

Your most important responsibility will be leading and developing your team. Through clear communication, involvement and hands-on leadership, you will create the structure and motivation needed for employees to succeed.

You will report to the Head of Value Stream and work closely with 4 other competent Production Managers to ensure efficient production and timely deliveries.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead, motivate and develop a team of more than 40 production employees, with a strong focus on wellbeing, collaboration and performance.

• Ensure efficient daily production operations, including resource allocation, capacity planning and delivery performance.

• Work closely with the department's Planner to coordinate production schedules, priorities and resources.

• Monitor production performance, quality, costs and relevant KPIs, and take action when improvements are needed.

• Drive continuous improvements through structured processes, Lean principles and 5S initiatives.

• Ensure a safe working environment and compliance with quality, safety and environmental standards.

• Manage the department's production budget and contribute to efficient use of resources.

• Strengthen collaboration across production departments and other functions to ensure a smooth production flow.

• The role requires professional communication skills in both Danish and English

**About You

**We're looking for someone who knows their way around a production floor, enjoys working with people and understands that great results don't happen on their own.

You enjoy being close to the daily operations, supporting your employees and creating an environment where everyone understands their responsibilities and works towards common goals. You are comfortable making decisions, setting priorities and maintaining an overview, even when plans change.

You bring structure to a busy production environment and have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working when improvements are needed.

We imagine that you:

• Have several years of management experience from a technical or industrial production environment.

• You may have a technical education or have learned your way through years of hands-on experience. What matters most is that you know production and how to lead people.

• Have a proven ability to lead, motivate and develop production teams.

• Understand production planning, capacity management and operational performance.

• Have experience with continuous improvement, preferably Lean and 5S.

• Are comfortable working with production data, KPIs and ERP systems.

• Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships across different teams and departments.

Above all, you are a leader who takes an interest in people, leads by example and takes pride in seeing your team succeed.

**About Us

**You will become part of a well-established international company with a strong Danish heritage, where relationships are highly valued. In 2026, Aasted became part of the Italian Piovan Group, opening new perspectives and opportunities as part of a larger international group in the years to come.

At Aasted, our culture is characterized by motivated employees who take pride in their work, creating a strong sense of teamwork and commitment. We value open, honest and direct communication and believe in treating people with respect and integrity in everything we do.

We continuously strive to create an inclusive workplace with equal opportunities for development for all employees. We offer an attractive parental leave scheme, social events and a nice canteen operated by Meyers Kantine.

At Aasted, we prioritize a healthy working environment and are therefore a smoke-free workplace. This means that smoking is not permitted during working hours or anywhere on company premises.

**We look forward to hearing from you

**We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your CV and application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions or would simply like to learn more about the position, please feel free to contact Head of Value Stream, Combined Lines Solutions, Maria Osk Sigurdardottir, at mao@aasted.eu.

At Aasted, we strive to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We therefore encourage everyone to apply, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or political and cultural background.

You can read more about us and what we do here: AASTED | Welcome to our world

**_Aasted – a Danish pioneer

_**_Aasted has been a market leader in equipment and production lines for chocolate manufacturing worldwide for more than 100 years. Our customer portfolio includes both smaller local businesses and some of the world's largest global FMCG companies.

__We are on a continuous journey driven by curiosity, which has enabled us to rethink what was previously considered possible in chocolate production. We challenge the impossible and make it possible. We continuously introduce a wide range of groundbreaking and patented solutions for our customers, helping each of them achieve their unique vision.

_At Aasted, we are more than 550 people who, through passion, experience and expertise, challenge the status quo.

_atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

__With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

__Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

__We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

__By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

_**People Transformation & Projects Lead - Help us connect strategy, people and execution

**At atNorth, growth creates a lot of opportunities. It also creates complexity.

As we continue to expand across markets, functions and countries, we need someone who can help connect the dots across the organization and turn ideas into action (and effective processes ;-) ).

We are looking for a People Transformation & Projects Lead to join our People Technology, Analytics & Process Excellence team. This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys working across organizational boundaries, solving complex challenges, manage stakeholders and driving meaningful change.

This is not a traditional P&C/HR role.

Instead, you will work at the intersection of People & Culture and other business functions where you will act as a bridge between teams, helping different stakeholders align around common goals and ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into practical solutions and measurable results.

**About The Role

**Success at atNorth requires more than great ideas. It requires collaboration, alignment and execution.

As People Transformation & Projects Lead, you will help connect business needs, people, processes and technology to create solutions that work in practice.

Some days you may be leading a cross-functional project involving Operations, IT and People & Culture. Other days you may be helping leaders navigate organizational challenges, improve ways of working or implement new initiatives.

Your role is to create momentum, remove obstacles and ensure that the right people are working together towards shared outcomes.

You will be part of the People Technology, Analytics & Projects team, working closely with specialists in HR technology, analytics, AI, process development and digital transformation

**Key responsibilities -> What will you do?

****_Drive transformation initiatives

_**

• Lead projects and initiatives from identified needs and business challenges through solution design, implementation and follow-up.

• Transform ideas into tangible actions and ensure delivery of measurable outcomes.

• Drive transformation and change initiatives, ensuring successful adoption of new ways of working, processes and organizational practices.

**_Connect functions and build bridges

_**

• Act as a connector across other areas as example; Operations, IT, Strategy, Finance and People & Culture.

• Bring together different perspectives, facilitate collaboration and ensure solutions work across organizational boundaries.

• Help break down silos and create stronger alignment between teams, priorities and ways of working.

**_Partner with the P&C Leadership Team

_**

• Work closely with the P&C Leadership Team to identify priorities, solve complex organizational challenges and accelerate execution of key initiatives.

• Provide structure, analysis and coordination to support decision-making and help ensure alignment between strategic objectives and operational delivery.

• Act as a sparring partner on organizational effectiveness, ways of working and business improvement opportunities.

**_Turn strategy into execution

_**

• Translate strategic priorities into practical plans and actions.

• Support leaders and stakeholders in moving from discussions and decisions to implementation and results.

**_Improve how we work & drive progress and accountability

_**

• Coordinate activities, stakeholders, timelines and dependencies across multiple initiatives.

• Support process improvements, organizational effectiveness and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Contribute to scalable ways of working that support atNorth's continued growth.

• Lead Process Excellence initiatives within People & Culture, driving the simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement of processes and ways of working to enhance efficiency, consistency, employee experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Your profile:

**You enjoy working where functions, ideas and challenges intersect and you rolemodel collaboration, accountability and a continuous improvement mindset.

You are naturally curious and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You quickly build relationships, understand different perspectives and help people find common ground.

You are equally comfortable discussing strategic priorities with senior leaders as rolling up your sleeves and contributing hands-on when needed.

Most importantly, you are someone who enjoys connecting people, teams and initiatives to achieve outcomes that no single function could deliver alone.

You communicate fluent in written and spoken in at least english and other nordic languages is meriting.

You have at least 5 years of experience from the majority areas listed below:

• Transformation and change management

• Project or program management

• Management consulting

• Business improvement initiatives

• Organizational development

• HR, Operations, Technology or Strategy functions

**About the atNorth Culture

**_We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

__We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

__We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

__At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.
